notes: V3 caller-facing capability catalog. Every record is independently reviewed. Website copy is an editorial source only; no live call fetches this file from the website.

capabilities.title: Inbound customer enquiries
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: Woxza can answer incoming customer enquiries and keep the next step clear when that workflow is configured.
capabilities.callerImpact: Fewer customer enquiries need to wait for a manual first response, and the team has a clearer next step to handle.

capabilities.title: Customer follow-up and updates
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: Woxza can be configured to keep customer follow-ups and updates moving, so they do not depend on someone remembering every call.
capabilities.callerImpact: The team can spend less time chasing routine updates and customers receive clearer, more timely follow-up.

capabilities.title: Connected systems and workflows
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: Woxza can be configured to work with a business's connected systems, such as its CRM, calendar, messaging, or business data.
capabilities.callerImpact: Approved call details can follow the business workflow instead of being copied between systems by hand.
requirements: the relevant system is connected and configured

capabilities.title: Appointment enquiries
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: For an appointment-based business, Woxza can be configured to handle appointment enquiries and use a connected calendar where one is set up.
capabilities.callerImpact: Routine appointment questions can be handled more consistently, leaving staff more time for customers or patients in front of them.
requirements: connected calendar when booking is needed

capabilities.title: Answers from connected business information
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: Once the right business information is connected, Woxza can answer from approved catalog, pricing, FAQ, or availability information instead of a generic script.
capabilities.callerImpact: Customers can receive more consistent answers without staff repeatedly looking up the same approved information.

capabilities.title: Stock-aware order enquiries
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: When stock rules are connected, Woxza can receive order enquiries using the available quantity so a caller is not promised something the business cannot fulfil.
capabilities.callerImpact: Customers receive clearer expectations on availability, while the team avoids routine order clarification and preventable mistakes.

capabilities.title: Configured business rules
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: After a business sets its information, rules, and handoff choices, Woxza can handle those routine conversations consistently.
capabilities.callerImpact: The customer experience can stay consistent even when staff are busy, while exceptions still reach the right person.

capabilities.title: Multilingual customer calls
capabilities.callerSafeClaim: Woxza can support customer conversations across the languages a business chooses for its workflow.
capabilities.callerImpact: Customers can communicate in supported languages that feel more comfortable for them.
